'''Lev''' the '''Master Chef''' is the third [[non-player character]] players meet in ''[[Old School RuneScape]]''. He lives on [[Tutorial Island]]. He teaches new players how to cook more sophisticated food and how the [[Music Player]] works.

Until the point in the tutorial when new players meet the master chef, the only thing they would have cooked are [[shrimps]] on a log [[fire]]. He teaches new players how to bake [[bread]] by combining a [[Pot of flour|flour]] with [[Bucket of water|water]] to make [[bread dough]], and then baking it on a [[range]].
